title: Shipping & Returns
intro: The essentials — full detail is confirmed at checkout and in your order emails.

sections.heading: Shipping
sections.body: Standard shipping is free on all orders over €150, and €6.95 on orders below that. Standard delivery arrives in 3–5 business days. Express shipping (1–2 business days) is available at checkout for €14.95. We currently ship within the EU and UK.

sections.heading: Order Tracking
sections.body: You'll receive a shipping confirmation once your order leaves the warehouse. Track its status any time from your account's Orders page.

sections.heading: Returns
sections.body: Unworn items with tags attached can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund to your original payment method. Start a return from your account's Returns page — we'll email a prepaid return label. Sale items marked 'Final Sale' are not eligible for return.

sections.heading: Exchanges
sections.body: We don't process direct exchanges — return the item for a refund and place a new order for the size or colour you'd prefer, so you're not waiting on stock availability.

sections.heading: Refund Timing
sections.body: Once your return is received and inspected, refunds are issued within 5–7 business days. It can take a further few days for your bank to post the credit.
